presets.name: Minecraft server
presets.description: Rank and VIP sales delivered over RCON, live server status, in-game account linking, vote rewards, a public ban list and player profiles.

presets.name: Hytale server
presets.description: Rank and cosmetic sales delivered over RCON, vote rewards, a ban list and player profiles. Delivery needs an RCON mod on the server: Hytale ships without one, and the community mods speak the Source protocol this module already talks.

presets.name: Rust server
presets.description: Kit and VIP sales delivered over RCON, wipe announcements, a ban list and a leaderboard. Players sign in with Steam, the account they already play on.

presets.name: ARK server
presets.description: Shop items and perks delivered over RCON, cluster and wipe announcements, a ban list and Steam sign-in.

presets.name: Counter-Strike 2 server
presets.description: VIP and rank sales delivered over RCON, a ban list, a staff roster and a leaderboard, with Steam sign-in throughout.

presets.name: Garry's Mod server
presets.description: Rank sales delivered over RCON, support tickets, a staff roster and a ban list. Steam sign-in, because a Gmod player already has an account.

presets.name: Unturned server
presets.description: The same shape as a Minecraft store: kit and rank sales delivered over RCON, vote rewards and a ban list, with Steam sign-in.

presets.name: FiveM roleplay
presets.description: Whitelist applications through custom forms, a staff roster, punishments and a donation store delivered over RCON.

presets.name: Roblox game
presets.description: Game pass and currency sales with trophies and a leaderboard, and Roblox sign-in. No RCON: Roblox has no server console to talk to.

presets.name: Online store
presets.description: Products, cart and checkout with two payment gateways, multi-currency, support tickets, SEO and a cookie banner.

presets.name: Digital products
presets.description: Sell software and licensed downloads: license keys issued on purchase, gated downloads, release notes, a knowledge base and support tickets. Two-factor is on because a buyer account holds their keys.

presets.name: I'll choose myself
presets.description: Start from nothing and pick modules by hand.
